inlineSql: Select * From ITEM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.IT_NAME As ItemNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL, B.GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.PR_CODE As PrCodeL,A.IT_TYPE As ItTypeL,A.TAG_TYPE As TagTypeL FROM ITEM_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN GROUP_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.GR_CODE = B.GR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.IT_NAME
Select * From DM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND DM_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT AC_NAME As KarigarL,AC_SHORT as CodeL FROM AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_SHORT <> '' ORDER BY AC_NAME
SELECT AC_NAME As KarigarL,AC_SHORT as CodeL FROM AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_SHORT <> '' ORDER BY AC_NAME

SELECT A.DESIGN_NO as DesignL,BOOK_NAME As BookNameL,B.PR_NAME As ProductL,A.ITM_SIZE as SizeL,A.KR_NAME As KrNameL,A.ITM_TOUCH As TouchR,A.ITM_WEST_PRC AS WestPrcR,A.LBR_PRC AS LbrPrcR,A.LBR_RATE As LbrRateR,A.DESIGN_IMG_ID As DesignIdL FROM (DESIGN_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.PR_CODE = B.PR_CODE) LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.PR_CODE = C.PR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.IT_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.BOOK_NAME,A.DESIGN_NO,A.SR_NO
Select * From TABLE_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' and LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND TABLE_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT TABLE_NAME As CounterL,TABLE_CODE as CodeL FROM TABLE_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME
Select * From LBR_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LBR_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT LBR_CODE As LbrCodeL,LBR_CATG as CategoryL,LBR_VAL As LbrValueR FROM LBR_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY LBR_CATG,LBR_CODE
INSERT INTO TAG_SET(CO_CODE,LC_CODE,CO_BOOK,VCH_NO,TAG_NO,VCH_SRNO,TAG_TYPE,PR_CODE) VALUES (' ? ',' ? ',' ? ',' ? ',' ? ',' ? ',' ? ',' ? ')

SELECT TOP 1 TAG_SRNO FROM (SELECT CAST(TAG_SRNO AS INT) AS TAG_SRNO FROM BAR_DETL WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' AND LEN(TAG_NO) > 6 AND LEN(TAG_NO) <=9 GROUP BY TAG_SRNO UNION ALL SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(A.TAG_NO,4,LEN(A.TAG_NO)) AS INT)) AS TAG_SRNO FROM SRNO_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND LEN(A.TAG_NO) > 6 AND LEN(A.TAG_NO) < =9 AND B.TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' ) AS X GROUP BY TAG_SRNO ORDER BY TAG_SRNO DESC

SELECT SUBSTRING(A.TAG_NO,4,LEN(A.TAG_NO)) AS TAG_SRNO FROM SRNO_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.TAG_NO DESC

SELECT MAX(TAG_SRNO) AS TAG_SRNO FROM BAR_DETL WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' UNION ALL SELECT MAX(SUBSTRING(A.TAG_NO,4,LEN(A.TAG_NO))) AS TAG_SRNO FROM SRNO_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND LEN(A.TAG_NO) > 6 AND B.TAG_TYPE = ' ? '
SELECT TOP 2 TAG_SRNO FROM BAR_DETL WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' ORDER BY TAG_SRNO DESC

SELECT TAG_NO ,'',0 FROM TAG_SET WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND LEN(TAG_NO) = 7 GROUP BY TAG_NO ORDER BY TAG_NO

Select A.TAG_NO From MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = B.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = B.VCH_SRNO WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' AND B.PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.IT_CODE <> '' AND A.TAG_NO <> 'N' AND LEN(A.TAG_NO) = 7 GROUP BY A.TAG_NO HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT TAG_NO FROM TAG_SET WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY TAG_NO ORDER BY TAG_NO
SELECT TAG_NO,SUBSTRING(TAG_NO,4,5) AS SrNo FROM BAR_DETL WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_NO <> '' AND TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' ORDER BY TAG_SRNO DESC
SELECT TAG_NO ,'',0 FROM TAG_SET WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_TYPE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? ' AND LEN(TAG_NO) = 8 GROUP BY TAG_NO ORDER BY TAG_NO

Select A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_TIME FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = B.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = B.VCH_SRNO WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO <> '' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' ? AND A.VCH_SRNO = ? AND B.EMP_ISU <> 'Y' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_TIME HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN ='+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE - A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY B.VCH_TIME DESC

Select A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,C.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,C.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,C.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,C.ITM_MRP as MrpR,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME From (MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = C.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = C.VCH_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO <> '' AND C.EMP_ISU <> 'Y' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,B.IT_NAME,A.IT_CODE,C.DESIGN_NO,C.ITM_GWT,C.ITM_NWT,C.ITM_MRP,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY A.TAG_NO,C.VCH_TIME DESC
